== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Let's Go Left (V) (Errata 3)]] (<code>1250_33</code>, Virtual Block 5 slip 33E), showing the '''PC-E3''' game text. No published image shows this text: the Virtual Block 5 release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB5-33E-Lets_Go_Left.png]]) shows the PC-E2 text of [[Let's Go Left (V) (Errata 2)]], and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB5-L-letsgoleft-pre.gif]]) prints the PC-E1 wording ([[Let's Go Left (V) (Errata)]]) (“their non-[Presence] characters (and vehicles)”).

* '''Text source:''' Players Committee website card list (VBlock5Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064732/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock5Type.html 21 July 2012] (Internet Archive), unchanged in every capture to 11 January 2013. The card list drops icons; icons are drawn as on the printed slip.
* '''PC-E3 text:''' “At each system a player controls with a capital starship, their non-[Presence] characters and vehicles deploy -1 to related sites and sectors. If you occupy a system with a capital starship (or three unique starships) and have no Objective on table, may add 1 to each of your Force drains at related battleground sites (opponent loses no more than 2 Force from those drains).”
* '''Made:''' 8 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 71): the card's own Virtual Legacy card <code>1005_L5680</code> (printed frame, art from the Players Committee card image, title, lore, icons, slip number, Virtual Block 5 set mark) with the PC-E3 game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
* '''Renamed:''' 11 November 2026 from <code>VB5-33E-Lets_Go_Left-PC-E1-cardmaker.png</code>: the versions were put in date order (Batch S1, versions ruling of 11 November 2026). The image itself is unchanged.
